preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of businesses is between 2 and 10^5, inclusive.
The value of each business is between 1 and 10^9, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Sum of N over all test cases <= 5 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The sum of all N values over all test cases is at most 5 * 10^5.

preconditions.expression: The given roads connect every business
preconditions.description: There is a path between any two businesses in the graph formed by the roads.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is a single integer representing the maximum possible damage.

invariants.expression: The maximum possible damage is determined by bombing exactly one business
invariants.description: The solution involves calculating the damage for each business and selecting the maximum.
